title: Assessing LLMs for Moral Value Pluralism
findings: The LLM (text-davinci-003) showed a pronounced traditional bias. It exhibited high resonance with the statement 'God is very important in my life' and high conflict with 'God is irrelevant to my life'. However, its alignment with teaching children religious faith was more mixed. The model inaccurately portrayed older demographics as more traditional (including religious values) than they are according to WVS data and struggled to model the more secular values of non-WEIRD nations like Japan and the Czech Republic.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the alignment of LLM-generated text with values on a traditional-secular axis. The 'traditional' end of this axis included values such as the importance of God in one's life and the importance of teaching children religious faith over independence.
